anya (Design): Quick accessibility check: in the new Insights sidebar the focused row highlight in light theme is almost invisible (thin 1px blue on white). Also keyboarding into the sidebar sometimes traps focus after collapsing a group. Can we triage?
leo (Frontend): Good catch. I suspect two things: the focus stroke is using the same color as the selected row highlight so it blends, and the collapse animation briefly removes nodes from the DOM which can break tab order.
anya (Design): Screenshot: attached. Expected: a clear focus ring, separate from selection state, and predictable tab order when collapsing groups.
dee (A11y): Notes: 1) WCAG doesn't specify focus contrast but it should be perceivable by keyboard users. Recommend at least 2.5px visible ring (or outline) with >=3:1 contrast vs immediate background. 2) For collapsible groups use aria-expanded on the toggle and keep the content in DOM during animation (use `height` transitions or `visibility: hidden` + inert) so focusable items aren't removed. 3) Consider `inert` polyfill or `aria-hidden` toggles with focus management.
kai (QA): Repro steps: open Insights, Tab until a group toggle, Enter to collapse, then Shift+Tab - focus sometimes lands in the main content. Happens in Chrome and FF on Mac. I recorded a quick screencap with VoiceOver; it reads the toggle twice on collapse.
leo (Frontend): Proposed quick CSS change while we iterate on design:
```
.sidebar .row:focus {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(0,107,164,0.18);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.sidebar .row[aria-selected='true'] {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,107,164,0.08);
}
```
And JS change: keep nodes mounted during transition, add `data-collapsing` class and `aria-hidden` only after animation completes.
anya (Design): I prefer a neutral focus ring for selection vs focus separation. Use neutral gray for outline and use brand tint for active/hover states. Will mock two variants.
dee (A11y): Also: - Add "aria-live=\"polite\"" only when content changes that users need to know. Avoid announcing state twice. - For keyboard: ensure arrow key navigation in the list respects roving tabindex if it's a listbox pattern. - Add `prefers-reduced-motion` support for collapsing groups.
kai (QA): I'll add an automated Cypress test: tab through sidebar, assert that when a group is collapsed, focus moves to the toggle and not into main content; also test Shift+Tab behavior. Will include VoiceOver smoke run in the pipeline for this PR.
leo (Frontend): I'll open a WIP PR with CSS + JS fix and screenshots. PR 1489. Tagging @anya for design review and @dee for a11y signoff.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for PR 1489 (staging).
anya (Design): Decision for immediate patch: 1) implement neutral 3px outline for focus, 2) keep DOM nodes during collapse and manage `aria-hidden` post-animation, 3) add prefers-reduced-motion. Revisit color nuance next sprint.
dee (A11y): Thanks. When PR is ready please add a short note in the release checklist: "Sidebar keyboard/focus improvements (accessibility)" so SE/CS know. Also add test coverage pointers.
kai (QA): I'll smoke test on Win+NVDA and Mac+VoiceOver once staging is up. Marking this P2 for now.
leo (Frontend): PR opened (1489). I'll paste screenshots and test results here as they land.
anya (Design): Thanks everyone 44d keep this thread updated with any regressions.
